تبايعت (form VI)
# تَبَايَعْتُ (tabāyaʕtu) /ta.baː.jaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
# تَبَايَعْتَ (tabāyaʕta) /ta.baː.jaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
# تَبَايَعْتِ (tabāyaʕti) /ta.baː.jaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
# تَبَايَعَتْ (tabāyaʕat) /ta.baː.ja.ʕat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
